steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. Each permit condition needs evidence, and each reporting date must be met.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Permit condition with a breach
findings.fix: Report the breach and correct the cause

findings.title: Reporting date missed
findings.fix: Submit the report and record the late submission

findings.title: Condition with no evidence
findings.fix: Attach the evidence for the condition

outcome.notChecked: The permit's legal effect; conditions not in the records.

input: The records for this review, as text or CSV

prompt: Use the rlm-ehs-permit-compliance skill on the records for this review.
